scripts.text:
[Striker Unit Commander]
Hey, who's there?
scripts.translation:
[突擊隊指揮官]
嘿，你是誰？

scripts.text: I am executing my mission with the Rebellion unit.
scripts.translation: 我正與反叛者部隊一起執行任務

scripts.text:
[Striker Unit Commander]
This place is dangerous and you must leave quickly. We are near the enemy base.
scripts.translation:
[突擊隊指揮官]
這裡很危險，你必須立刻離開。我們離敵方基地很近。

scripts.text:
[Striker Unit Commander]
We are arranging the situation inside the base. We cannot let you in yet.
scripts.translation:
[突擊隊指揮官]
我們正在安排基地內部的行動，暫時還不能讓你進去。

scripts.text:
^0000ffSeems like the base has been arranged inside. ^000000
[Striker Unit Commander]
Once we are ready for the operation, you will get in there with me.
scripts.translation:
^0000ff基地內部似乎已經部署完畢。^000000
[突擊隊指揮官]
等行動準備就緒後，我會帶你進去。

scripts.text:
[Striker Unit Commander]
Once we are ready for the operation, you will get in there with me.
scripts.translation:
[突擊隊指揮官]
等行動準備就緒後，我會帶你進去。

scripts.text:
[Striker Unit Commander]
By the way, did you receive a briefing from the general Julian? Come back after receiving the briefing.
scripts.translation:
[突擊隊指揮官]
對了，聽過朱利安將軍的作戰說明了嗎？聽完再來。

scripts.text:
[Striker Unit Commander]
Once we are ready for the operation, you will get in there with me.
scripts.translation:
[突擊隊指揮官]
等行動準備就緒後，我會帶你進去。

scripts.text: ^0000ffSeems like an adventurer without his/her unit (party) cannot enter.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff似乎沒有所屬隊伍的冒險者無法進入。^000000

scripts.text:
[Striker Unit Commander]
The field of operation is Heart Hunter War Base 2 Check whether the operation was applied properly.
scripts.translation:
[突擊隊指揮官]
本次行動地點是心之獵手戰爭基地2號。請確認行動部署是否妥當。

scripts.text:
[Striker Unit Commander]
The field of operation is Heart Hunter War Base 1 Check whether the operation was applied properly.
scripts.translation:
[突擊隊指揮官]
本次行動地點是心之獵手戰爭基地1號。請確認行動部署是否妥當。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Goint to the outer boundary of Heart Hunter War Base without clearing the Heart Hunter War Base is prohibited. Also, you cannot enter the Heart Hunter War Base that has already been cleared. Please check your operation point^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000必須先攻下心之獵手戰爭基地，才能前往基地外圍；已經通關的基地也不能再次進入。請核對當前行動進度。^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000This is when your progress is different from your party leader of the party member. In this case, find another party member who can go to the same place with you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000你的進度與隊長或隊員不一致。請尋找能與你前往同一區域的隊員。^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000The entry is also impossible if the Memorial Dungeon has not been created as an operation field.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000尚未建立作為行動區域的記憶副本時，也無法進入。^000000

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生未知錯誤。

scripts.text: ^ff0000If you deal with monsters arbitrarily inside a dungeon, such as Monster taming, it will not be regarded as a normal progress. Please be aware of it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000在副本中馴服魔物等處理方式不會計入正常任務進度，請留意。^000000

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Stop, which unit are you from? According to your answer, we may have to suppress you using an armed force.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
站住！哪個部隊的？想清楚再回答，否則我們可能會動用武力。

scripts.text: I am executing my mission with the Rebellion unit.
scripts.translation: 我正與反叛者部隊一起執行任務

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Hmm, you are our troop? Since the scouting is not over yet, don't wander around here carelessly.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
嗯，你是我們的人？偵察工作還沒結束，不要在這裡隨意走動。

scripts.text: ^ff0000If you deal with monsters arbitrarily inside a dungeon, such as Monster taming, it will not be regarded as a normal progress. Please be aware of it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000在副本中馴服魔物等處理方式不會計入正常任務進度，請留意。^000000

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Are you a deserter wandering around without a position?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
沒有所屬部隊還到處亂跑，你是逃兵嗎？

scripts.text: ^ff0000Only the party leader can talk to Julian in detail.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000只有隊長才能與朱利安詳細交談。^000000

scripts.text:
[Julian]
We are arranging the situation inside the base. You cannot enter yet.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我們正在安排基地內部的行動，暫時還不能進去。

scripts.text: ^0000ffSeems like the base has been arranged inside. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff基地內部似乎已經部署完畢。^000000

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Are you the augmentation force in striking Heart Hunter base? I think we met before.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你就是來協助突襲心之獵手基地的援軍？總覺得以前見過你。

scripts.text: Just a thought.
scripts.translation: 只是隨口一說

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Well, it doesn't matter. You should have a rough idea of what's going on here. Just remember that it's not going to be an easy task.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
沒關係。你應該對這裡的情況有個大概的瞭解。記住，這不會是一個簡單的任務。

scripts.text: Explain the situation to me.
scripts.translation: 向我解釋一下情況

scripts.text: No time, let's proceed now.
scripts.translation: 沒時間了，現在出發

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Sounds cool. You are like a foreign legion, so stay beside me during the operation.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
爽快。
你相當於外援，行動時跟在我身邊。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Hmm, you haven't received a briefing yet? Since we don't have enough time, let me explain briefly.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
嗯，還沒聽過作戰說明？時間緊，我就簡單講講。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
We don't have enough forces to strike the base.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我們沒有足夠的兵力來強攻基地。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
For the sake of mobility, we abandoned heavy firearms. Since our top priority mission is to occupy the base without destroying it much, most of explosive weapons have been excluded as well.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
為了保持機動性，我們沒帶重型火器。
首要任務是儘量完好地佔領基地，所以大部分爆破武器也沒帶。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
If necessary, we can reinforce our firearms using the terrain features in the field... But it must be minimized.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
必要時，可以藉助現場地形增強火力...不過要儘量少用。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
In any case, most of the operation must be anti-personnel damage and the base facilities have to be maintained whenever possible.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
總之，行動以消滅敵方人員為主，基地設施能保留就儘量保留。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Our advance party has secured the boundary surface in the southern base. We will take that route to move to the central part. And each striker unit will move in an individual route.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
先遣隊已控制基地南部邊界，我們就從那裡進入中心區域。
各突擊隊則分別沿其他路線行動。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
You are like a foreign legion, so stay beside me during the operation. Any more question? Of course, I won't take any, even though you have one.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你相當於外援，行動時跟著我。
還有問題嗎？當然，有也不回答。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
After that, follow the instruction of the chief of your unit. Once the gate to the base is opened, talk to the Striker Unit Commander over there and start.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
之後聽從所屬部隊長官的指揮。
等基地大門一開，就去找那邊的突擊隊指揮官，開始行動。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
If you are ready, I will let you know the attack time.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
如果你準備好了，我會告訴你攻擊時間。

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text: I need some more time.
scripts.translation: 我還需要一點時間

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I see. Since we are in a hurry, complete your preparation quickly and let me know.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
知道了，時間緊，抓緊準備，好了告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
After that, follow the instruction of the chief of your unit. Once the gate to the base is opened, talk to the Striker Unit Commander over there and start.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
之後聽從所屬部隊長官的指揮。
等基地大門一開，就去找那邊的突擊隊指揮官，開始行動。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Have you been to the toilet? I was looking for you.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你去上廁所了嗎？我在找你。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
If you are ready, I will let you know the attack time.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
如果你準備好了，我會告訴你攻擊時間。

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text: I need some more time.
scripts.translation: 我還需要一點時間

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I see. Since we are in a hurry, complete your preparation quickly and let me know.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
知道了，時間緊，抓緊準備，好了告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
After that, follow the instruction of the chief of your unit. Once the gate to the base is opened, talk to the Striker Unit Commander over there and start.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
之後聽從所屬部隊長官的指揮。
等基地大門一開，就去找那邊的突擊隊指揮官，開始行動。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
There is a broad vacant land on the outer boundary of the base we have occupied. We built a training ground there, but the facilities are imperfect. I need elite personnel who can examine it.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
佔領的基地外圍有片空地，我們在那裡建了訓練場，不過設施還不完善。
需要精銳人員去測試一下。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Oh, isn't this the first time I tell you this? I would be glad if you can examine the facilities. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
哦，這事我是不是已經提過了？
能幫忙測試一下設施就好了，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Let me do it.
scripts.translation: 讓我去做

scripts.text: Maybe next time...
scripts.translation: 下次再說吧

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I got it. I asked a little too much.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
明白，是我強人所難了。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
It will open soon. Once the gate to the base is opened, talk to the Striker Unit Commander over there and start.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
馬上就要開始了。一旦基地大門開啟，就去和那邊的突擊隊指揮官交談，然後開始行動。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
We don't have time to joke
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我們沒有時間開玩笑了。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
We can just sneak in like this. But we'd better secure a path for the cleanup party. How can we do that?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
就這樣潛進去倒是沒問題，不過最好替後續清理部隊開條路。
怎麼做呢？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Why are they all coming out all of a sudden. Just hand me the gunpowder
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
怎麼突然全冒出來了？先把火藥給我。

scripts.text: Give him the gunpowder
scripts.translation: 把火藥給他

scripts.text:
[Julian]
It takes some time in assembling the explosive. You go up and check if there is any threat.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
組裝爆破裝置得花點時間，你先上去檢視有沒有危險。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
If you find an enemy, don't forget to kill it without reporting me.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
發現敵人就直接幹掉，不用向我報告。

scripts.text:
There is a warning written in red color.
-----------------------
[^ff0000Do not push^000000]
Stop it.
scripts.translation: 停下

scripts.text: Push the button
scripts.translation: 按下按鈕

scripts.text: I never push a suspicious button.
scripts.translation: 我從不按下可疑的按鈕。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Is the gunpowder ready?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
火藥準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Is the gunpowder ready?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
火藥準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Give him the gunpowder
scripts.translation: 把火藥給他

scripts.text:
[Ebel]
You... Enemy? Our troop? Which side are you on?
scripts.translation:
[埃貝爾]
你...是敵人？還是我們的部隊？你到底是哪邊的？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Hmm. The engineers need to repair the occupied base. It's time for battle force step outside.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
嗯，工兵得修復我們佔領的基地了，戰鬥人員該先撤出去。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
I'm talking to your leader now {0}.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我正在和你的隊長說話，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
{0}, is this your first visit here?
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
{0}，這是你第一次來這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, it is.
scripts.translation: 是的，確實如此

scripts.text: No, I've been here before.
scripts.translation: 不，我以前來過

scripts.text:
[Julian]
You safely passed Section 1. Now help us with the defense training for Section 2.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
你安全通過了第一區。現在請協助我們進行第二區的防禦訓練。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
This security system here controls plenty of system devices over there.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
這裡的安保系統控制著那邊大量的系統裝置。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
If you activate the device, they will open a narrow passage you can barely go through.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
啟動裝置後，會開啟一條勉強能讓你通過的狹窄通道。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Unless you activate the device, the defensive training does not start. Activate it when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
只有啟動裝置，防禦訓練才會開始。
準備好再動手。

scripts.text:
You can see an unusually attractive
red button.
---------------------
^ff0000[Do not push]^000000
scripts.translation:
你可以看到一個異常引人注目的紅色按鈕。
---------------------
^ff0000[請勿按下]^000000

scripts.text: Ignore it
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Push it
scripts.translation: 按下它

scripts.text: You ignored the button and stepped back. Nothing happened.
scripts.translation: 你無視了那個按鈕，退後了一步。什麼也沒發生。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
We have something as the last resort, in case we fail to defend the base. It's time to test it now.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
萬一守不住基地，我們還留了一張底牌。
現在就來測試它。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Enter the door in front of you.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
進入你面前的門。

scripts.text:
[Ebel]
Are you my companion? Or an enemy? Which side are you on?
scripts.translation:
[埃貝爾]
你是我的同伴？還是敵人？你站在哪一邊？

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Wait for a while {0} we will proceed once your unit leader comes.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
稍等一下，{0}，等你的隊長來了我們再繼續。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
It took me more than a week until I was able to talk to her. Now she speaks well.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
我花了一個多星期才讓她願意跟我說話。現在她說話很流利了。

scripts.text: Are you close enough to call her by the first name?
scripts.translation: 你們已經熟到能直呼名字了？

scripts.text: I know. Let's start right now.
scripts.translation: 我知道。我們現在就開始吧

scripts.text:
[Julian]
No, don't look at me like that. This girl would never talk to other guys. So I became in charge of her.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
別那樣看我。
這姑娘不肯跟其他人說話，所以才由我負責照顧她。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
... It's real.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
...是真的。

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Hmm. Great. Let's start right away.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
嗯。很好。我們馬上開始。

scripts.text:
[Ebel]
Where did you learn the technique you have used a moment ago?
scripts.translation:
[埃貝爾]
你剛才用的那招是在哪裡學的？

scripts.text:
[Ebel]
...

[Ebel]
Where did you learn the technique you have used a moment ago?
scripts.translation:
[埃貝爾]
你剛才用的那招是在哪裡學的？

scripts.text:
[Ebel]
You... You're stronger than me. I have never experienced this before...
scripts.translation:
[埃貝爾]
你...你比我強。我以前從未經歷過這種感覺...

scripts.text:
[Julian]
Hmm. Good job. Let us leave the training ground. The gateway is upstairs. Go up the stairs behind me.
scripts.translation:
[朱利安]
嗯，幹得不錯，離開訓練場吧。
傳送門在樓上，走我身後的樓梯上去。
